en: By now in this course, we learned how to
name things properly and to not overuse
comments.
We haven't worked too much on the actual
code which we write except for the names we
assign to things.
Now therefore, in this course section, we
are going to take a closer look at functions
because functions ultimately are where we
write the majority of our code. Functions or
methods.
And in this course section, you will learn
how to write clean functions.
And we'll have a look at every aspect of
functions. We'll have a look at the
parameters, the arguments you use in
functions, and how to be clean there.
And of course, we're going to have a look at
the function body. And we're going to talk
about the length of functions, abstraction
levels, and how to properly split one
function into multiple functions to increase
readability.
And as always, we're going to do this with a
bunch of examples, demos, and also a
challenge for you.
So let's dive in.
